screens.label: Home
rules: Claim Ad Gems can disappear and shift the left column.
Difficulty controls change tier; verify the displayed tier after each input.
Preset button and selected-preset text only exist when available.

screens.label: Cards
rules: Crop icons from inventory without changing deck. Read names, stars, mastery and green equipped check separately.
Locks indicate cards cannot be swapped during a run. Discover full inventory; no fixed six-card limit.
Presets and equipped slot count vary. Buying cards is opt-in spending, never setup.

screens.label: Modules
rules: Four primary slots; optional assists must be examined but never purchased during scan.
Equipped modules are absent from inventory. Capture full slot identities before any unequip.
Crop inventory art first, then open descriptor to identify the clicked tile.
Restoration must verify every saved primary and assist assignment before reporting completion.

screens.label: Guild
rules: Four weekly chest positions; distinguish collected, claimable and locked.

screens.label: Guardians
rules: Chip inventory logical positions are fixed; unlocks and presets vary. Equipped slots and inventory are distinct.

screens.label: Guild Store
rules: Scrollable sections Currencies, Themes, Relics and Guardian chips; locate items relative to headings. No purchases for mapping.

screens.label: Bots
rules: Presets vary up to user-described five. Owned bots differ; detect On/Off state, never unlock for mapping.

screens.label: Shop
rules: Free gem card identified by gem icon, x20 and Free text. Limited offers can shift its position.
Only free gem claims supported automatically; paid offers and website gift excluded.

screens.label: Tournament
rules: Never enter or purchase tickets during mapping. Battle availability depends on tournament state.

screens.label: Occasional tournament information
rules: Optional interruption; identify message and OK separately from normal navigation.

screens.label: Daily missions
rules: Quest claim is relative to its card. Weekly rewards scroll horizontally and are identified by threshold and state.

screens.label: Event missions
rules: Quest tiers award 10, 15, 20 medals; boost doubles rewards. Daily claim limit and event quest progress are separate.
Reward relic claim is relative to its relic slot; paid and free tracks are distinct.

screens.label: Event shop
rules: Sections move with scroll. Themes, relics and songs use section-relative item positions.
Currency and shard purchases are manual-only; optional theme/relic buying requires explicit policy and budget.
Two standard relics and four rotating relics were described; detect actual availability and prices.

screens.label: Themes
rules: Top tabs: Profile, Themes, Relics. Category tabs: Tower, Background, Music, Menus.
Quest skin swap must save original, equip another, restore original and verify.

screens.label: Battle History
rules: Rows identify a run by multiple fields, not skin icon alone.

screens.label: Battle report
rules: Read labels and values; Copy offers a text export. Verify run identity.

screens.label: Global presets
rules: Top preset loads five assignments: Workshop, Cards, Bots, Modules, Guardians.
Changing a lower selection edits the selected global preset. Names and counts are account-local.

screens.label: Workshop
rules: Entire Workshop is manual-only; never upgrade, enhance, respec or open Ultimate Weapons for setup.

screens.label: First Perk
rules: User preference must be configurable; no universal selection.

screens.label: Ban Perks
rules: Selected slots lie between section titles; number unlocked varies. Green tick on available card indicates selected.

screens.label: Auto Pick priority
rules: Rank capacity varies; beyond-capacity and banned rows differ. Right arrow moves up one, left moves down one.

screens.label: Module details
rules: Read name after opening the clicked inventory tile; match detail art to the source tile.
Equip, Unequip and role dialog are distinct actions. Dialog height varies.

screens.label: Primary or Assist
rules: Verify module identity before choosing role.

screens.label: Merge modules
rules: Preview lists proposed merges with checkboxes; confirm only under enabled merge policy.

screens.label: Shatter modules
rules: Locked modules are protected. Selection toggles; maximum 12 per batch per user.
Confirm can open a second rare-module warning. Never shatter as a mapping action.

screens.label: Guardian chip details
rules: Long press reveals name and three parameters; do not assume owned levels.

screens.label: Labs
rules: Open a slot name to reach selection; never change research for mapping.

screens.label: Research selection
rules: Range filter limits research list to adjustable skills.

screens.label: Research range values
rules: Adjust using + and - then close; never press Research for range adjustment.

screens.label: Reward reveal
rules: Next advances rewards; Skip collects all when present. Single-type rewards may omit Skip.

screens.label: Game stats
rules: Snapshot report and selected perks before Retry or Home. Retry repeats the farm run; Home returns Home.

screens.label: Battle perks
rules: Progress shows current wave / next perk wave, or New Perk.
Unchecked Auto Pick allows manual or app-controlled choices.
Only rows between Choose a New Perk and Selected Perks are current offers.
After selection recapture; stacked choices may require repeated selection.

screens.label: Orb Distance Adjuster
rules: Separate from tower range; +, -, slider, close. Opening pauses game; closing restores speed in observed test.

screens.label: Target Priority
rules: Drag rows to reorder; higher rows take priority. Low automation priority.

screens.label: Exit battle
rules: Go Home preserves a resumable battle; Surrender ends it.

controls.label: Tower health, overheal, attack, regeneration and coin multiplier
Tier, wave, enemy attack and health

screens.label: Battle HUD
rules: Bottom category titles and tabs are fixed while content scrolls.
Three upgrade grids have stable logical ordering. Ultimate Weapon roster is account-specific.

screens.label: Attack
rules: Read visible rows before input; initial scroll offset is unknown.

screens.label: Defense

body.note: All game images are captured locally from your game. Reference sizes are guidance, not scaling instructions. Variants are alternatives; only capture appearances your emulator actually shows. Capturing an image is not proof that recognition works.

steps.instructions: Open Home yourself. Capture each named control or header while unobscured. Do not press Battle. Open and close the preset picker yourself to capture its header, close control and None row.
steps.title: 1. Home and safe navigation

steps.instructions: Open Cards from Home. Capture the screen header, active label and named card art without changing the deck. Preset names are discovered by the basic scan after navigation is prepared.
steps.title: 2. Cards

steps.instructions: Open Modules, then open a module's details. Capture the named header, close and Equip controls without activating them. Primary/Assist prompts are observed only during an explicitly requested equipment change; never unlock, transfer levels or shatter to collect an image.
steps.title: 3. Modules

steps.instructions: Open Guild, Members and Guardian pages yourself. Capture the named tab, header, chip or empty/equipped marker. Skip unavailable chips; do not buy or equip one for the scan.
steps.title: 4. Guild and Guardians

steps.instructions: Open Events, Bots and missions yourself. Capture tabs and claim controls when naturally available. Do not spend currency to produce a claim.
steps.title: 5. Events and missions

steps.instructions: Open the store yourself and visit the named section. Capture headers, free-claim controls and owned labels. For storefont, crop one occurrence of the named digit from the actual store font. Do not buy anything.
steps.title: 6. Store

steps.instructions: Full setup starts its own normal run and reads the wave digits, upgrade labels and Ultimate Weapon names. If Intro Sprint is visible, it opens the prompt and ends the sprint; setup does not change cards to make it appear. Otherwise you start or continue a normal battle and the scan only watches. For digits, use the wave counter; for valuefont, use the value display. Capture each literal character separately at native size. Never touch a tournament run.
steps.title: 7. Observe a normal battle

steps.instructions: Full setup captures these by surrendering the run it started itself (exit dialog, GAME STATS, reward skip). Manual capture only watches: do not surrender someone else's run, trigger abilities, transfer levels or shatter modules to obtain a missing image.
steps.title: 8. Observe results and dialogs

steps.instructions: You control tournament entry and all confirmations. Capture the named entry, ticket, heat, leaderboard or result control only when it is naturally visible. Setup never buys a ticket, watches an entry ad, enters or ends a tournament.
steps.title: 9. Observe tournament screens

steps.instructions: Wait for this overlay during normal use. Capture only the named close or return control. Setup must not click an unknown ad or overlay.
steps.title: 10. Observe overlays

steps.instructions: Open Home yourself. Capture each named control or header while unobscured. Do not press Battle. Open and close the preset picker yourself to capture its header, close control and None row.
steps.title: 1. Home and safe navigation

steps.instructions: Open Cards from Home. Capture the screen header, active label and named card art without changing the deck. Preset names are discovered by the basic scan after navigation is prepared.
steps.title: 2. Cards

steps.instructions: Open Modules, then open a module's details. Capture the named header, close and Equip controls without activating them. Primary/Assist prompts are observed only during an explicitly requested equipment change; never unlock, transfer levels or shatter to collect an image.
steps.title: 3. Modules

steps.instructions: Open Guild, Members and Guardian pages yourself. Capture the named tab, header, chip or empty/equipped marker. Skip unavailable chips; do not buy or equip one for the scan.
steps.title: 4. Guild and Guardians

steps.instructions: Open Events, Bots and missions yourself. Capture tabs and claim controls when naturally available. Do not spend currency to produce a claim.
steps.title: 5. Events and missions

steps.instructions: Open the store yourself and visit the named section. Capture headers, free-claim controls and owned labels. For storefont, crop one occurrence of the named digit from the actual store font. Do not buy anything.
steps.title: 6. Store

steps.instructions: Full setup starts its own normal run and reads the wave digits, upgrade labels and Ultimate Weapon names. If Intro Sprint is visible, it opens the prompt and ends the sprint; setup does not change cards to make it appear. Otherwise you start or continue a normal battle and the scan only watches. For digits, use the wave counter; for valuefont, use the value display. Capture each literal character separately at native size. Never touch a tournament run.
steps.title: 7. Observe a normal battle

steps.instructions: Full setup captures these by surrendering the run it started itself (exit dialog, GAME STATS, reward skip). Manual capture only watches: do not surrender someone else's run, trigger abilities, transfer levels or shatter modules to obtain a missing image.
steps.title: 8. Observe results and dialogs

steps.instructions: You control tournament entry and all confirmations. Capture the named entry, ticket, heat, leaderboard or result control only when it is naturally visible. Setup never buys a ticket, watches an entry ad, enters or ends a tournament.
steps.title: 9. Observe tournament screens

steps.instructions: Wait for this overlay during normal use. Capture only the named close or return control. Setup must not click an unknown ad or overlay.
steps.title: 10. Observe overlays

body.note: All game images are captured locally from your game. Reference sizes are guidance, not scaling instructions. Variants are alternatives; only capture appearances your emulator actually shows. Capturing an image is not proof that recognition works.

steps.instructions: Open Home yourself. Capture each named control or header while unobscured. Do not press Battle. Open and close the preset picker yourself to capture its header, close control and None row.
steps.title: 1. Home and safe navigation

steps.instructions: Open Cards from Home. Capture the screen header, active label and named card art without changing the deck. Preset names are discovered by the basic scan after navigation is prepared.
steps.title: 2. Cards

steps.instructions: Open Modules, then open a module's details. Capture the named header, close and Equip controls without activating them. Primary/Assist prompts are observed only during an explicitly requested equipment change; never unlock, transfer levels or shatter to collect an image.
steps.title: 3. Modules

steps.instructions: Open Guild, Members and Guardian pages yourself. Capture the named tab, header, chip or empty/equipped marker. Skip unavailable chips; do not buy or equip one for the scan.
steps.title: 4. Guild and Guardians

steps.instructions: Open Events, Bots and missions yourself. Capture tabs and claim controls when naturally available. Do not spend currency to produce a claim.
steps.title: 5. Events and missions

steps.instructions: Open the store yourself and visit the named section. Capture headers, free-claim controls and owned labels. For storefont, crop one occurrence of the named digit from the actual store font. Do not buy anything.
steps.title: 6. Store

steps.instructions: Full setup starts its own normal run and reads the wave digits, upgrade labels and Ultimate Weapon names. If Intro Sprint is visible, it opens the prompt and ends the sprint; setup does not change cards to make it appear. Otherwise you start or continue a normal battle and the scan only watches. For digits, use the wave counter; for valuefont, use the value display. Capture each literal character separately at native size. Never touch a tournament run.
steps.title: 7. Observe a normal battle

steps.instructions: Full setup captures these by surrendering the run it started itself (exit dialog, GAME STATS, reward skip). Manual capture only watches: do not surrender someone else's run, trigger abilities, transfer levels or shatter modules to obtain a missing image.
steps.title: 8. Observe results and dialogs

steps.instructions: You control tournament entry and all confirmations. Capture the named entry, ticket, heat, leaderboard or result control only when it is naturally visible. Setup never buys a ticket, watches an entry ad, enters or ends a tournament.
steps.title: 9. Observe tournament screens

steps.instructions: Wait for this overlay during normal use. Capture only the named close or return control. Setup must not click an unknown ad or overlay.
steps.title: 10. Observe overlays

body.note: All game images are captured locally from your game. Reference sizes are guidance, not scaling instructions. Variants are alternatives; only capture appearances your emulator actually shows. Capturing an image is not proof that recognition works.

steps.instructions: Open Home yourself. Capture each named control or header while unobscured. Do not press Battle. Open and close the preset picker yourself to capture its header, close control and None row.
steps.title: 1. Home and safe navigation

steps.instructions: Open Cards from Home. Capture the screen header, active label and named card art without changing the deck. Preset names are discovered by the basic scan after navigation is prepared.
steps.title: 2. Cards

steps.instructions: Open Modules, then open a module's details. Capture the named header, close and Equip controls without activating them. Primary/Assist prompts are observed only during an explicitly requested equipment change; never unlock, transfer levels or shatter to collect an image.
steps.title: 3. Modules

steps.instructions: Open Guild, Members and Guardian pages yourself. Capture the named tab, header, chip or empty/equipped marker. Skip unavailable chips; do not buy or equip one for the scan.
steps.title: 4. Guild and Guardians

steps.instructions: Open Events, Bots and missions yourself. Capture tabs and claim controls when naturally available. Do not spend currency to produce a claim.
steps.title: 5. Events and missions

steps.instructions: Open the store yourself and visit the named section. Capture headers, free-claim controls and owned labels. For storefont, crop one occurrence of the named digit from the actual store font. Do not buy anything.
steps.title: 6. Store

steps.instructions: Full setup starts its own normal run and reads the wave digits, upgrade labels and Ultimate Weapon names. If Intro Sprint is visible, it opens the prompt and ends the sprint; setup does not change cards to make it appear. Otherwise you start or continue a normal battle and the scan only watches. For digits, use the wave counter; for valuefont, use the value display. Capture each literal character separately at native size. Never touch a tournament run.
steps.title: 7. Observe a normal battle

steps.instructions: Full setup captures these by surrendering the run it started itself (exit dialog, GAME STATS, reward skip). Manual capture only watches: do not surrender someone else's run, trigger abilities, transfer levels or shatter modules to obtain a missing image.
steps.title: 8. Observe results and dialogs

steps.instructions: You control tournament entry and all confirmations. Capture the named entry, ticket, heat, leaderboard or result control only when it is naturally visible. Setup never buys a ticket, watches an entry ad, enters or ends a tournament.
steps.title: 9. Observe tournament screens

steps.instructions: Wait for this overlay during normal use. Capture only the named close or return control. Setup must not click an unknown ad or overlay.
steps.title: 10. Observe overlays

steps.instructions: Open Home yourself. Capture each named control or header while unobscured. Do not press Battle. Open and close the preset picker yourself to capture its header, close control and None row.
steps.title: 1. Home and safe navigation

steps.instructions: Open Cards from Home. Capture the screen header, active label and named card art without changing the deck. Preset names are discovered by the basic scan after navigation is prepared.
steps.title: 2. Cards

steps.instructions: Open Modules, then open a module's details. Capture the named header, close and Equip controls without activating them. Primary/Assist prompts are observed only during an explicitly requested equipment change; never unlock, transfer levels or shatter to collect an image.
steps.title: 3. Modules

steps.instructions: Open Guild, Members and Guardian pages yourself. Capture the named tab, header, chip or empty/equipped marker. Skip unavailable chips; do not buy or equip one for the scan.
steps.title: 4. Guild and Guardians

steps.instructions: Open Events, Bots and missions yourself. Capture tabs and claim controls when naturally available. Do not spend currency to produce a claim.
steps.title: 5. Events and missions

steps.instructions: Open the store yourself and visit the named section. Capture headers, free-claim controls and owned labels. For storefont, crop one occurrence of the named digit from the actual store font. Do not buy anything.
steps.title: 6. Store

steps.instructions: Full setup starts its own normal run and reads the wave digits, upgrade labels and Ultimate Weapon names. If Intro Sprint is visible, it opens the prompt and ends the sprint; setup does not change cards to make it appear. Otherwise you start or continue a normal battle and the scan only watches. For digits, use the wave counter; for valuefont, use the value display. Capture each literal character separately at native size. Never touch a tournament run.
steps.title: 7. Observe a normal battle

steps.instructions: Full setup captures these by surrendering the run it started itself (exit dialog, GAME STATS, reward skip). Manual capture only watches: do not surrender someone else's run, trigger abilities, transfer levels or shatter modules to obtain a missing image.
steps.title: 8. Observe results and dialogs

steps.instructions: You control tournament entry and all confirmations. Capture the named entry, ticket, heat, leaderboard or result control only when it is naturally visible. Setup never buys a ticket, watches an entry ad, enters or ends a tournament.
steps.title: 9. Observe tournament screens

steps.instructions: Wait for this overlay during normal use. Capture only the named close or return control. Setup must not click an unknown ad or overlay.

body.note: All game images are captured locally from your game. Reference sizes are guidance, not scaling instructions. Variants are alternatives; only capture appearances your emulator actually shows. Capturing an image is not proof that recognition works.

steps.instructions: Open Home yourself. Capture each named control or header while unobscured. Do not press Battle. Open and close the preset picker yourself to capture its header, close control and None row.
steps.title: 1. Home and safe navigation

steps.instructions: Open Cards from Home. Capture the screen header, active label and named card art without changing the deck. Preset names are discovered by the basic scan after navigation is prepared.
steps.title: 2. Cards

steps.instructions: Open Modules, then open a module's details. Capture the named header, close and Equip controls without activating them. Primary/Assist prompts are observed only during an explicitly requested equipment change; never unlock, transfer levels or shatter to collect an image.
steps.title: 3. Modules

steps.instructions: Open Guild, Members and Guardian pages yourself. Capture the named tab, header, chip or empty/equipped marker. Skip unavailable chips; do not buy or equip one for the scan.
steps.title: 4. Guild and Guardians

steps.instructions: Open Events, Bots and missions yourself. Capture tabs and claim controls when naturally available. Do not spend currency to produce a claim.
steps.title: 5. Events and missions

steps.instructions: Open the store yourself and visit the named section. Capture headers, free-claim controls and owned labels. For storefont, crop one occurrence of the named digit from the actual store font. Do not buy anything.
steps.title: 6. Store

steps.instructions: Full setup starts its own normal run and reads the wave digits, upgrade labels and Ultimate Weapon names. If Intro Sprint is visible, it opens the prompt and ends the sprint; setup does not change cards to make it appear. Otherwise you start or continue a normal battle and the scan only watches. For digits, use the wave counter; for valuefont, use the value display. Capture each literal character separately at native size. Never touch a tournament run.
steps.title: 7. Observe a normal battle

steps.instructions: Full setup captures these by surrendering the run it started itself (exit dialog, GAME STATS, reward skip). Manual capture only watches: do not surrender someone else's run, trigger abilities, transfer levels or shatter modules to obtain a missing image.
steps.title: 8. Observe results and dialogs

steps.instructions: You control tournament entry and all confirmations. Capture the named entry, ticket, heat, leaderboard or result control only when it is naturally visible. Setup never buys a ticket, watches an entry ad, enters or ends a tournament.
steps.title: 9. Observe tournament screens

steps.instructions: Wait for this overlay during normal use. Capture only the named close or return control. Setup must not click an unknown ad or overlay.
steps.title: 10. Observe overlays

body.note: All game images are captured locally from your game. Reference sizes are guidance, not scaling instructions. Variants are alternatives; only capture appearances your emulator actually shows. Capturing an image is not proof that recognition works.

steps.instructions: Open Home yourself. Capture each named control or header while unobscured. Do not press Battle. Open and close the preset picker yourself to capture its header, close control and None row.
steps.title: 1. Home and safe navigation

steps.instructions: Open Cards from Home. Capture the screen header, active label and named card art without changing the deck. Preset names are discovered by the basic scan after navigation is prepared.
steps.title: 2. Cards

steps.instructions: Open Modules, then open a module's details. Capture the named header, close and Equip controls without activating them. Primary/Assist prompts are observed only during an explicitly requested equipment change; never unlock, transfer levels or shatter to collect an image.
steps.title: 3. Modules

steps.instructions: Open Guild, Members and Guardian pages yourself. Capture the named tab, header, chip or empty/equipped marker. Skip unavailable chips; do not buy or equip one for the scan.
steps.title: 4. Guild and Guardians

steps.instructions: Open Events, Bots and missions yourself. Capture tabs and claim controls when naturally available. Do not spend currency to produce a claim.
steps.title: 5. Events and missions

steps.instructions: Open the store yourself and visit the named section. Capture headers, free-claim controls and owned labels. For storefont, crop one occurrence of the named digit from the actual store font. Do not buy anything.
steps.title: 6. Store

steps.instructions: Full setup starts its own normal run and reads the wave digits, upgrade labels and Ultimate Weapon names. If Intro Sprint is visible, it opens the prompt and ends the sprint; setup does not change cards to make it appear. Otherwise you start or continue a normal battle and the scan only watches. For digits, use the wave counter; for valuefont, use the value display. Capture each literal character separately at native size. Never touch a tournament run.

targets.label: second wind
targets.status: Needs attention: This copy was not cut from this emulator

steps.title: 7. Observe a normal battle

steps.instructions: Full setup captures these by surrendering the run it started itself (exit dialog, GAME STATS, reward skip). Manual capture only watches: do not surrender someone else's run, trigger abilities, transfer levels or shatter modules to obtain a missing image.

targets.label: end round yes
targets.status: Needs attention: The saved image no longer matches the screen

steps.title: 8. Observe results and dialogs

steps.instructions: You control tournament entry and all confirmations. Capture the named entry, ticket, heat, leaderboard or result control only when it is naturally visible. Setup never buys a ticket, watches an entry ad, enters or ends a tournament.
steps.title: 9. Observe tournament screens

steps.instructions: Wait for this overlay during normal use. Capture only the named close or return control. Setup must not click an unknown ad or overlay.
steps.title: 10. Observe overlays

body.note: All game images are captured locally from your game. Reference sizes are guidance, not scaling instructions. Variants are alternatives; only capture appearances your emulator actually shows. Capturing an image is not proof that recognition works.

steps.instructions: Open Home yourself. Capture each named control or header while unobscured. Do not press Battle. Open and close the preset picker yourself to capture its header, close control and None row.
steps.title: 1. Home and safe navigation

steps.instructions: Open Cards from Home. Capture the screen header, active label and named card art without changing the deck. Preset names are discovered by the basic scan after navigation is prepared.
steps.title: 2. Cards

steps.instructions: Open Modules, then open a module's details. Capture the named header, close and Equip controls without activating them. Primary/Assist prompts are observed only during an explicitly requested equipment change; never unlock, transfer levels or shatter to collect an image.
steps.title: 3. Modules

steps.instructions: Open Guild, Members and Guardian pages yourself. Capture the named tab, header, chip or empty/equipped marker. Skip unavailable chips; do not buy or equip one for the scan.
steps.title: 4. Guild and Guardians

steps.instructions: Open Events, Bots and missions yourself. Capture tabs and claim controls when naturally available. Do not spend currency to produce a claim.
steps.title: 5. Events and missions

steps.instructions: Open the store yourself and visit the named section. Capture headers, free-claim controls and owned labels. For storefont, crop one occurrence of the named digit from the actual store font. Do not buy anything.
steps.title: 6. Store

steps.instructions: Full setup starts its own normal run and reads the wave digits, upgrade labels and Ultimate Weapon names. If Intro Sprint is visible, it opens the prompt and ends the sprint; setup does not change cards to make it appear. Otherwise you start or continue a normal battle and the scan only watches. For digits, use the wave counter; for valuefont, use the value display. Capture each literal character separately at native size. Never touch a tournament run.
steps.title: 7. Observe a normal battle

steps.instructions: Full setup captures these by surrendering the run it started itself (exit dialog, GAME STATS, reward skip). Manual capture only watches: do not surrender someone else's run, trigger abilities, transfer levels or shatter modules to obtain a missing image.
steps.title: 8. Observe results and dialogs

steps.instructions: You control tournament entry and all confirmations. Capture the named entry, ticket, heat, leaderboard or result control only when it is naturally visible. Setup never buys a ticket, watches an entry ad, enters or ends a tournament.
steps.title: 9. Observe tournament screens

steps.instructions: Wait for this overlay during normal use. Capture only the named close or return control. Setup must not click an unknown ad or overlay.
steps.title: 10. Observe overlays

screens.label: Home
rules: Claim Ad Gems can disappear and shift the left column.
Difficulty controls change tier; verify the displayed tier after each input.
Preset button and selected-preset text only exist when available.

screens.label: Cards
rules: Crop icons from inventory without changing deck. Read names, stars, mastery and green equipped check separately.
Locks indicate cards cannot be swapped during a run. Discover full inventory; no fixed six-card limit.
Presets and equipped slot count vary. Buying cards is opt-in spending, never setup.

screens.label: Modules
rules: Four primary slots; optional assists must be examined but never purchased during scan.
Equipped modules are absent from inventory. Capture full slot identities before any unequip.
Crop inventory art first, then open descriptor to identify the clicked tile.
Restoration must verify every saved primary and assist assignment before reporting completion.

screens.label: Guild
rules: Four weekly chest positions; distinguish collected, claimable and locked.

screens.label: Guardians
rules: Chip inventory logical positions are fixed; unlocks and presets vary. Equipped slots and inventory are distinct.

screens.label: Guild Store
rules: Scrollable sections Currencies, Themes, Relics and Guardian chips; locate items relative to headings. No purchases for mapping.

screens.label: Bots
rules: Presets vary up to user-described five. Owned bots differ; detect On/Off state, never unlock for mapping.

screens.label: Shop
rules: Free gem card identified by gem icon, x20 and Free text. Limited offers can shift its position.
Only free gem claims supported automatically; paid offers and website gift excluded.

rules: Never enter or purchase tickets during mapping. Battle availability depends on tournament state.

rules: Optional interruption; identify message and OK separately from normal navigation.

screens.label: Daily missions
rules: Quest claim is relative to its card. Weekly rewards scroll horizontally and are identified by threshold and state.

screens.label: Event missions
rules: Quest tiers award 10, 15, 20 medals; boost doubles rewards. Daily claim limit and event quest progress are separate.
Reward relic claim is relative to its relic slot; paid and free tracks are distinct.

screens.label: Event shop
rules: Sections move with scroll. Themes, relics and songs use section-relative item positions.
Currency and shard purchases are manual-only; optional theme/relic buying requires explicit policy and budget.
Two standard relics and four rotating relics were described; detect actual availability and prices.

Quest skin swap must save original, equip another, restore original and verify.

orbiting_gem.rule: Verify the pink square and faceted glyph against the same frame HUD diamond; measure the current tower-relative radius before bounded arc clicks. Recheck recognition and radius before each click, only in a verified battle and away from abilities. A failed detection is unknown. Only a stable exact +2 balance confirms collection. No stored artwork or template writes are required. Do not scale by attack-range meters.

second_wind.rule: Detect onset then integrate real elapsed time times game speed, accounting for pauses. Late detection has uncertain remaining duration.

body.note: All game images are captured locally from your game. Reference sizes are guidance, not scaling instructions. Variants are alternatives; only capture appearances your emulator actually shows. Capturing an image is not proof that recognition works.

steps.instructions: Open Home yourself. Capture each named control or header while unobscured. Do not press Battle. Open and close the preset picker yourself to capture its header, close control and None row.
steps.title: 1. Home and safe navigation

steps.instructions: Open Cards from Home. Capture the screen header, active label and named card art without changing the deck. Preset names are discovered by the basic scan after navigation is prepared.
steps.title: 2. Cards

steps.instructions: Open Modules, then open a module's details. Capture the named header, close and Equip controls without activating them. Primary/Assist prompts are observed only during an explicitly requested equipment change; never unlock, transfer levels or shatter to collect an image.
steps.title: 3. Modules

steps.instructions: Open Guild, Members and Guardian pages yourself. Capture the named tab, header, chip or empty/equipped marker. Skip unavailable chips; do not buy or equip one for the scan.
steps.title: 4. Guild and Guardians

steps.instructions: Open Events, Bots and missions yourself. Capture tabs and claim controls when naturally available. Do not spend currency to produce a claim.
steps.title: 5. Events and missions

steps.instructions: Open the store yourself and visit the named section. Capture headers, free-claim controls and owned labels. For storefont, crop one occurrence of the named digit from the actual store font. Do not buy anything.
steps.title: 6. Store

steps.instructions: Full setup starts its own normal run and reads the wave digits, upgrade labels and Ultimate Weapon names. If Intro Sprint is visible, it opens the prompt and ends the sprint; setup does not change cards to make it appear. Otherwise you start or continue a normal battle and the scan only watches. For digits, use the wave counter; for valuefont, use the value display. Capture each literal character separately at native size. Never touch a tournament run.
steps.title: 7. Observe a normal battle

steps.instructions: Full setup captures these by surrendering the run it started itself (exit dialog, GAME STATS, reward skip). Manual capture only watches: do not surrender someone else's run, trigger abilities, transfer levels or shatter modules to obtain a missing image.
steps.title: 8. Observe results and dialogs

steps.instructions: You control tournament entry and all confirmations. Capture the named entry, ticket, heat, leaderboard or result control only when it is naturally visible. Setup never buys a ticket, watches an entry ad, enters or ends a tournament.
steps.title: 9. Observe tournament screens

steps.instructions: Wait for this overlay during normal use. Capture only the named close or return control. Setup must not click an unknown ad or overlay.
steps.title: 10. Observe overlays

body.note: All game images are captured locally from your game. Reference sizes are guidance, not scaling instructions. Variants are alternatives; only capture appearances your emulator actually shows. Capturing an image is not proof that recognition works.

steps.instructions: Open Home yourself. Capture each named control or header while unobscured. Do not press Battle. Open and close the preset picker yourself to capture its header, close control and None row.
steps.title: 1. Home and safe navigation

steps.instructions: Open Cards from Home. Capture the screen header, active label and named card art without changing the deck. Preset names are discovered by the basic scan after navigation is prepared.
steps.title: 2. Cards

steps.instructions: Open Modules, then open a module's details. Capture the named header, close and Equip controls without activating them. Primary/Assist prompts are observed only during an explicitly requested equipment change; never unlock, transfer levels or shatter to collect an image.
steps.title: 3. Modules

steps.instructions: Open Guild, Members and Guardian pages yourself. Capture the named tab, header, chip or empty/equipped marker. Skip unavailable chips; do not buy or equip one for the scan.
steps.title: 4. Guild and Guardians

steps.instructions: Open Events, Bots and missions yourself. Capture tabs and claim controls when naturally available. Do not spend currency to produce a claim.
steps.title: 5. Events and missions

steps.instructions: Open the store yourself and visit the named section. Capture headers, free-claim controls and owned labels. For storefont, crop one occurrence of the named digit from the actual store font. Do not buy anything.
steps.title: 6. Store

steps.instructions: Full setup starts its own normal run and reads the wave digits, upgrade labels and Ultimate Weapon names. If Intro Sprint is visible, it opens the prompt and ends the sprint; setup does not change cards to make it appear. Otherwise you start or continue a normal battle and the scan only watches. For digits, use the wave counter; for valuefont, use the value display. Capture each literal character separately at native size. Never touch a tournament run.
steps.title: 7. Observe a normal battle

steps.instructions: Full setup captures these by surrendering the run it started itself (exit dialog, GAME STATS, reward skip). Manual capture only watches: do not surrender someone else's run, trigger abilities, transfer levels or shatter modules to obtain a missing image.
steps.title: 8. Observe results and dialogs

steps.instructions: You control tournament entry and all confirmations. Capture the named entry, ticket, heat, leaderboard or result control only when it is naturally visible. Setup never buys a ticket, watches an entry ad, enters or ends a tournament.
steps.title: 9. Observe tournament screens

steps.instructions: Wait for this overlay during normal use. Capture only the named close or return control. Setup must not click an unknown ad or overlay.
steps.title: 10. Observe overlays

Recheck recognition and radius before each click, only in a verified battle and away from abilities. A failed detection is unknown. Only a stable exact +2 balance confirms collection. body.note: All game images are captured locally from your game. Reference sizes are guidance, not scaling instructions. Variants are alternatives; only capture appearances your emulator actually shows. Capturing an image is not proof that recognition works.

steps.instructions: Open Home yourself. Capture each named control or header while unobscured. Do not press Battle. Open and close the preset picker yourself to capture its header, close control and None row.
steps.title: 1. Home and safe navigation

steps.instructions: Open Cards from Home. Capture the screen header, active label and named card art without changing the deck. Preset names are discovered by the basic scan after navigation is prepared.
steps.title: 2. Cards

steps.instructions: Open Modules, then open a module's details. Capture the named header, close and Equip controls without activating them. Primary/Assist prompts are observed only during an explicitly requested equipment change; never unlock, transfer levels or shatter to collect an image.
steps.title: 3. Modules

steps.instructions: Open Guild, Members and Guardian pages yourself. Capture the named tab, header, chip or empty/equipped marker. Skip unavailable chips; do not buy or equip one for the scan.
steps.title: 4. Guild and Guardians

steps.instructions: Open Events, Bots and missions yourself. Capture tabs and claim controls when naturally available. Do not spend currency to produce a claim.
steps.title: 5. Events and missions

steps.instructions: Open the store yourself and visit the named section. Capture headers, free-claim controls and owned labels. For storefont, crop one occurrence of the named digit from the actual store font. Do not buy anything.
steps.title: 6. Store

steps.instructions: Full setup starts its own normal run and reads the wave digits, upgrade labels and Ultimate Weapon names. If Intro Sprint is visible, it opens the prompt and ends the sprint; setup does not change cards to make it appear. Otherwise you start or continue a normal battle and the scan only watches. For digits, use the wave counter; for valuefont, use the value display. Capture each literal character separately at native size. Never touch a tournament run.
steps.title: 7. Observe a normal battle

steps.instructions: Full setup captures these by surrendering the run it started itself (exit dialog, GAME STATS, reward skip). Manual capture only watches: do not surrender someone else's run, trigger abilities, transfer levels or shatter modules to obtain a missing image.
steps.title: 8. Observe results and dialogs

steps.instructions: You control tournament entry and all confirmations. Capture the named entry, ticket, heat, leaderboard or result control only when it is naturally visible. Setup never buys a ticket, watches an entry ad, enters or ends a tournament.
steps.title: 9. Observe tournament screens

steps.instructions: Wait for this overlay during normal use. Capture only the named close or return control. Setup must not click an unknown ad or overlay.
steps.title: 10. Observe overlays

modules.description: Shared gathering policy. Runs: farm

fields.description: Minimum time between attempt starts after taps were sent but collection was not confirmed. An attempt that sent no taps retries after the safety backoff. A recognized gem starts the first attempt; a confirmed claim resumes watching after tap pacing. Defaults to 16 minutes from the previous attempt's start; this is not a gem spawn period.
fields.label: Retry spacing after unconfirmed taps

fields.description: Minimum time between tap sets during a collection attempt. Farming and confirmation continue between sets. A tap near the input cutoff keeps this much time for stable exact +2 confirmation; later observations do not extend that cutoff.
fields.label: Time between tap sets while seeking

fields.description: Maximum time to send taps for a recognized gem, or to seek one after Run now. Input stops at this cutoff. The last dispatched tap retains one tap-set interval for stable exact +2 confirmation. Refusals do not extend either cutoff.
fields.label: Maximum floating gem claim attempt

fields.description: Wait after an input safety refusal, and at least this long after an attempt times out. Unknown balances or gems are checked again while keeping the same tap spacing and claim deadline.
fields.label: Safety backoff during a floating gem attempt

modules.title: Ad Gems · all on

modules.description: Shared gathering policy. Runs: farm

fields.description: Minimum time between attempt starts after taps were sent but collection was not confirmed. An attempt that sent no taps retries after the safety backoff. A recognized gem starts the first attempt; a confirmed claim resumes watching after tap pacing. Defaults to 16 minutes from the previous attempt's start; this is not a gem spawn period.
fields.label: Retry spacing after unconfirmed taps

fields.description: Minimum time between tap sets during a collection attempt. Farming and confirmation continue between sets. A tap near the input cutoff keeps this much time for stable exact +2 confirmation; later observations do not extend that cutoff.
fields.label: Time between tap sets while seeking

fields.description: Maximum time to send taps for a recognized gem, or to seek one after Run now. Input stops at this cutoff. The last dispatched tap retains one tap-set interval for stable exact +2 confirmation. Refusals do not extend either cutoff.
fields.label: Maximum floating gem claim attempt

fields.description: Wait after an input safety refusal, and at least this long after an attempt times out. Unknown balances or gems are checked again while keeping the same tap spacing and claim deadline.
fields.label: Safety backoff during a floating gem attempt

fields.description: Random response delay after observing a HUD Ad Gems offer.
fields.label: Gem response delay

fields.description: Minimum distance from every button edge, including tap jitter and press drift.
fields.label: Button edge inset

fields.description: Random interval between checks for an ad-gem offer.
fields.label: Offer check interval

fields.description: Time from the start of one collection window to the next, even when no gem is collected. Defaults to 12 minutes.
fields.label: Interval between collection windows

fields.description: Stop attempts after this duration, or immediately after a confirmed claim. Farming continues between checks.
fields.label: Maximum collection window

fields.description: Random wait before checking again; a visible offer then gets its response delay.

modules.title: Ad Gems · all on

modules.description: Shared gathering policy. Runs: farm

fields.description: Minimum time between attempt starts after taps were sent but collection was not confirmed. An attempt that sent no taps retries after the safety backoff. A recognized gem starts the first attempt; a confirmed claim resumes watching after tap pacing. Defaults to 16 minutes from the previous attempt's start; this is not a gem spawn period.
fields.label: Retry spacing after unconfirmed taps

fields.description: Minimum time between tap sets during a collection attempt. Farming and confirmation continue between sets. A tap near the input cutoff keeps this much time for stable exact +2 confirmation; later observations do not extend that cutoff.
fields.label: Time between tap sets while seeking

fields.description: Maximum time to send taps for a recognized gem, or to seek one after Run now. Input stops at this cutoff. The last dispatched tap retains one tap-set interval for stable exact +2 confirmation. Refusals do not extend either cutoff.
fields.label: Maximum floating gem claim attempt

fields.description: Wait after an input safety refusal, and at least this long after an attempt times out. Unknown balances or gems are checked again while keeping the same tap spacing and claim deadline.
fields.label: Safety backoff during a floating gem attempt

fields.description: Minimum time between attempt starts after taps were sent but collection was not confirmed. An attempt that sent no taps retries after the safety backoff. A recognized gem starts the first attempt; a confirmed claim resumes watching after tap pacing. Defaults to 16 minutes from the previous attempt's start; this is not a gem spawn period.
fields.label: Retry spacing after unconfirmed taps

fields.description: Minimum time between tap sets during a collection attempt. Farming and confirmation continue between sets. A tap near the input cutoff keeps this much time for stable exact +2 confirmation; later observations do not extend that cutoff.
fields.label: Time between tap sets while seeking

fields.description: Maximum time to send taps for a recognized gem, or to seek one after Run now. Input stops at this cutoff. The last dispatched tap retains one tap-set interval for stable exact +2 confirmation. Refusals do not extend either cutoff.
fields.label: Maximum floating gem claim attempt

fields.description: Wait after an input safety refusal, and at least this long after an attempt times out. Unknown balances or gems are checked again while keeping the same tap spacing and claim deadline.
fields.label: Safety backoff during a floating gem attempt

fields.description: Minimum time between attempt starts after taps were sent but collection was not confirmed. An attempt that sent no taps retries after the safety backoff. A recognized gem starts the first attempt; a confirmed claim resumes watching after tap pacing. Defaults to 16 minutes from the previous attempt's start; this is not a gem spawn period.
fields.label: Retry spacing after unconfirmed taps

fields.description: Minimum time between tap sets during a collection attempt. Farming and confirmation continue between sets. A tap near the input cutoff keeps this much time for stable exact +2 confirmation; later observations do not extend that cutoff.
fields.label: Time between tap sets while seeking

fields.description: Maximum time to send taps for a recognized gem, or to seek one after Run now. Input stops at this cutoff. The last dispatched tap retains one tap-set interval for stable exact +2 confirmation. Refusals do not extend either cutoff.
fields.label: Maximum floating gem claim attempt

fields.description: Wait after an input safety refusal, and at least this long after an attempt times out. Unknown balances or gems are checked again while keeping the same tap spacing and claim deadline.
fields.label: Safety backoff during a floating gem attempt

fields.description: Minimum time between attempt starts after taps were sent but collection was not confirmed. An attempt that sent no taps retries after the safety backoff. A recognized gem starts the first attempt; a confirmed claim resumes watching after tap pacing. Defaults to 16 minutes from the previous attempt's start; this is not a gem spawn period.
fields.label: Retry spacing after unconfirmed taps

fields.description: Minimum time between tap sets during a collection attempt. Farming and confirmation continue between sets. A tap near the input cutoff keeps this much time for stable exact +2 confirmation; later observations do not extend that cutoff.
fields.label: Time between tap sets while seeking

fields.description: Maximum time to send taps for a recognized gem, or to seek one after Run now. Input stops at this cutoff. The last dispatched tap retains one tap-set interval for stable exact +2 confirmation. Refusals do not extend either cutoff.
fields.label: Maximum floating gem claim attempt

fields.description: Wait after an input safety refusal, and at least this long after an attempt times out. Unknown balances or gems are checked again while keeping the same tap spacing and claim deadline.
fields.label: Safety backoff during a floating gem attempt

modules.title: Ad Gems · all on

modules.description: Shared gathering policy. Runs: farm

fields.description: Minimum time between attempt starts after taps were sent but collection was not confirmed. An attempt that sent no taps retries after the safety backoff. A recognized gem starts the first attempt; a confirmed claim resumes watching after tap pacing. Defaults to 16 minutes from the previous attempt's start; this is not a gem spawn period.
fields.label: Retry spacing after unconfirmed taps

fields.description: Minimum time between tap sets during a collection attempt. Farming and confirmation continue between sets. A tap near the input cutoff keeps this much time for stable exact +2 confirmation; later observations do not extend that cutoff.
fields.label: Time between tap sets while seeking

fields.description: Maximum time to send taps for a recognized gem, or to seek one after Run now. Input stops at this cutoff. The last dispatched tap retains one tap-set interval for stable exact +2 confirmation. Refusals do not extend either cutoff.
fields.label: Maximum floating gem claim attempt

fields.description: Wait after an input safety refusal, and at least this long after an attempt times out. Unknown balances or gems are checked again while keeping the same tap spacing and claim deadline.
fields.label: Safety backoff during a floating gem attempt

fields.description: Random response delay after observing a HUD Ad Gems offer.

fields.description: Time from the start of one collection window to the next, even when no gem is collected. Defaults to 12 minutes.

modules.title: Ad Gems · all on

modules.description: Shared gathering policy. Runs: farm

fields.description: Minimum time between attempt starts after taps were sent but collection was not confirmed. An attempt that sent no taps retries after the safety backoff. A recognized gem starts the first attempt; a confirmed claim resumes watching after tap pacing. Defaults to 16 minutes from the previous attempt's start; this is not a gem spawn period.
fields.label: Retry spacing after unconfirmed taps

fields.description: Minimum time between tap sets during a collection attempt. Farming and confirmation continue between sets. A tap near the input cutoff keeps this much time for stable exact +2 confirmation; later observations do not extend that cutoff.
fields.label: Time between tap sets while seeking

fields.description: Maximum time to send taps for a recognized gem, or to seek one after Run now. Input stops at this cutoff. The last dispatched tap retains one tap-set interval for stable exact +2 confirmation. Refusals do not extend either cutoff.
fields.label: Maximum floating gem claim attempt

fields.description: Wait after an input safety refusal, and at least this long after an attempt times out. Unknown balances or gems are checked again while keeping the same tap spacing and claim deadline.
fields.label: Safety backoff during a floating gem attempt

modules.title: Ad Gems · all on

modules.description: Shared gathering policy. Runs: farm

fields.description: Minimum time between attempt starts after taps were sent but collection was not confirmed. An attempt that sent no taps retries after the safety backoff. A recognized gem starts the first attempt; a confirmed claim resumes watching after tap pacing. Defaults to 16 minutes from the previous attempt's start; this is not a gem spawn period.
fields.label: Retry spacing after unconfirmed taps

fields.description: Minimum time between tap sets during a collection attempt. Farming and confirmation continue between sets. A tap near the input cutoff keeps this much time for stable exact +2 confirmation; later observations do not extend that cutoff.
fields.label: Time between tap sets while seeking

fields.description: Maximum time to send taps for a recognized gem, or to seek one after Run now. Input stops at this cutoff. The last dispatched tap retains one tap-set interval for stable exact +2 confirmation. Refusals do not extend either cutoff.
fields.label: Maximum floating gem claim attempt

fields.description: Wait after an input safety refusal, and at least this long after an attempt times out. Unknown balances or gems are checked again while keeping the same tap spacing and claim deadline.
fields.label: Safety backoff during a floating gem attempt

modules.title: Ad Gems · all on

modules.description: Shared gathering policy. Runs: farm

fields.description: Minimum time between attempt starts after taps were sent but collection was not confirmed. An attempt that sent no taps retries after the safety backoff. A recognized gem starts the first attempt; a confirmed claim resumes watching after tap pacing. Defaults to 16 minutes from the previous attempt's start; this is not a gem spawn period.
fields.label: Retry spacing after unconfirmed taps

fields.description: Minimum time between tap sets during a collection attempt. Farming and confirmation continue between sets. A tap near the input cutoff keeps this much time for stable exact +2 confirmation; later observations do not extend that cutoff.
fields.label: Time between tap sets while seeking

fields.description: Maximum time to send taps for a recognized gem, or to seek one after Run now. Input stops at this cutoff. The last dispatched tap retains one tap-set interval for stable exact +2 confirmation. Refusals do not extend either cutoff.
fields.label: Maximum floating gem claim attempt

fields.description: Wait after an input safety refusal, and at least this long after an attempt times out. Unknown balances or gems are checked again while keeping the same tap spacing and claim deadline.
fields.label: Safety backoff during a floating gem attempt

fields.description: Random response delay after observing a HUD Ad Gems offer.
fields.label: Gem response delay

fields.description: Minimum distance from every button edge, including tap jitter and press drift.
fields.label: Button edge inset

fields.description: Random interval between checks for an ad-gem offer.
fields.label: Offer check interval

fields.description: Time from the start of one collection window to the next, even when no gem is collected. Defaults to 12 minutes.
fields.label: Interval between collection windows

fields.description: Stop attempts after this duration, or immediately after a confirmed claim. Farming continues between checks.
fields.label: Maximum collection window

modules.title: Ad Gems · all on

modules.description: Shared gathering policy. Runs: farm

fields.description: Minimum time between attempt starts after taps were sent but collection was not confirmed. An attempt that sent no taps retries after the safety backoff. A recognized gem starts the first attempt; a confirmed claim resumes watching after tap pacing. Defaults to 16 minutes from the previous attempt's start; this is not a gem spawn period.
fields.label: Retry spacing after unconfirmed taps

fields.description: Minimum time between tap sets during a collection attempt. Farming and confirmation continue between sets. A tap near the input cutoff keeps this much time for stable exact +2 confirmation; later observations do not extend that cutoff.
fields.label: Time between tap sets while seeking

fields.description: Maximum time to send taps for a recognized gem, or to seek one after Run now. Input stops at this cutoff. The last dispatched tap retains one tap-set interval for stable exact +2 confirmation. Refusals do not extend either cutoff.
fields.label: Maximum floating gem claim attempt

fields.description: Wait after an input safety refusal, and at least this long after an attempt times out. Unknown balances or gems are checked again while keeping the same tap spacing and claim deadline.
fields.label: Safety backoff during a floating gem attempt

modules.description: Shared gathering policy. Runs: farm

fields.description: Minimum time between attempt starts after taps were sent but collection was not confirmed. An attempt that sent no taps retries after the safety backoff. A recognized gem starts the first attempt; a confirmed claim resumes watching after tap pacing. Defaults to 16 minutes from the previous attempt's start; this is not a gem spawn period.
fields.label: Retry spacing after unconfirmed taps

fields.description: Minimum time between tap sets during a collection attempt. Farming and confirmation continue between sets. A tap near the input cutoff keeps this much time for stable exact +2 confirmation; later observations do not extend that cutoff.
fields.label: Time between tap sets while seeking

fields.description: Maximum time to send taps for a recognized gem, or to seek one after Run now. Input stops at this cutoff. The last dispatched tap retains one tap-set interval for stable exact +2 confirmation. Refusals do not extend either cutoff.
fields.label: Maximum floating gem claim attempt

fields.description: Wait after an input safety refusal, and at least this long after an attempt times out. Unknown balances or gems are checked again while keeping the same tap spacing and claim deadline.
fields.label: Safety backoff during a floating gem attempt
